title: phlomoides kaufmanniana
intro: Phlomoides kaufmanniana, commonly known as Kaufmann's phlomoides or Kaufmann's marsh clover, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve respiratory issues, while its bioactive constituents include phenolic compounds and flavonoids that exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the plant is believed to have health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and reducing oxidative stress.
